description: This file is a C header defining interfaces, macros, enums, and constants for the MeshAgent component, including logging, URL management, state control, and device updates.

methods.name: msgBusInit
methods.description: Initializes the Message Bus and registers the component with the stack.

methods.name: _MESHAGENT_LOG
methods.description: Logs messages at specified levels with formatted output.

methods.name: Mesh_SetUrl
methods.description: Sets the Mesh agent URL and notifies the vendor.

methods.name: Mesh_SetEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the Mesh service.

methods.name: Mesh_SetMeshState
methods.description: Sets the state of the Mesh service (e.g., full, monitor).

methods.name: Mesh_SetMeshWifiOptimizationMode
methods.description: Sets the Mesh WiFi optimization mode.

methods.name: Mesh_SetReinitPeriod
methods.description: Sets the reinitialization period for Mesh.

methods.name: Mesh_SetMeshWifiOptimizationMqttBroker
methods.description: Configures the MQTT broker for Mesh WiFi optimization.

methods.name: Mesh_GetEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the Mesh service is enabled.

methods.name: Mesh_UpdateConnectedDevice
methods.description: Updates the connected device table and notifies Mesh of changes.
